rows.comment: Daniels (elbow) completed 17 of 25 passes for 199 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing nine times for 103 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Giants. He also threw a successful two-point conversion.

rows.name: Deatrich Wise Jr.
rows.comment: The Commanders activated Wise (quadriceps) from the reserve/PUP list Saturday, and he no longer has an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Trey Amos
rows.comment: Amos (ankle) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Jeremy McNichols
rows.comment: McNichols (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Sam Cosmi
rows.comment: Cosmi (concussion/throat) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Frankie Luvu
rows.comment: Luvu (groin) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Giants.

rows.name: Sonny Styles
rows.comment: Styles (groin) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

rows.name: Ben Sinnott
rows.comment: Sinnott (ribs) upgraded to full participation at Thursday's practice.
